name: AOBench
description: AOBench (Agent Operations Benchmark) is an open-source Python benchmark framework for evaluating AI agents that operate High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems. It measures whether an agent completes HPC operational tasks — job scheduling, telemetry interpretation, energy reasoning, and policy enforcement — using the right tools, roles, and permissions. Every task is evaluated against a deterministic environment snapshot with mock HPC tools (SLURM, telemetry, RBAC, docs, facility), so results are role-aware, permission-enforced, trace-based, and reproducible. Six of the 29 environment snapshots and eight of the 88 tasks are grounded in the public Marconi100 ExaData dataset from CINECA's 980-node Tier-0 supercomputer.
